description:
`no_wrap=True` on a table column has stopped doing anything: the column is squeezed like any other when the table is too wide, and its text wraps.

```python
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table

table = Table(box=None, show_header=False, padding=(0, 1))
table.add_column(no_wrap=True)
table.add_column()
table.add_row("2024-01-01 12:00:00", "a long description that needs to wrap over several lines")
Console(width=40).print(table)
```

```
 2024-01-01          a long description 
 12:00:00            that needs to wrap 
                     over several lines 
```

The timestamp column should keep its full 19 cells and only the second column should be narrowed and wrapped:

```
 2024-01-01 12:00:00  a long            
                      description that  
                      needs to wrap     
                      over several      
                      lines             
```

When the column cannot keep its width at all — the same column declared with `width=8` — its content should be cropped to a single line (`2024-01…`, or `2024-01-` with `overflow="crop"`), but the rest of the text now wraps onto a second line (`12:00:00`) under it. Both halves of the option are lost: the column no longer resists being shrunk, and what is in it is wrapped anyway.

diff --git a/tests/test_repopilot_rich_006.py b/tests/test_repopilot_rich_006.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d54a1e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repopilot_rich_006.py
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import io
+
+from rich.console import Console
+from rich.table import Table
+
+
+def _render(table: Table, width: int) -> str:
+    console = Console(
+        file=io.StringIO(),
+        width=width,
+        force_terminal=False,
+        color_system=None,
+        legacy_windows=False,
+    )
+    console.print(table)
+    return console.file.getvalue()
+
+
+def _table(**first_column) -> Table:
+    table = Table(box=None, show_header=False, padding=(0, 1))
+    table.add_column(no_wrap=True, **first_column)
+    table.add_column()
+    table.add_row("2024-01-01 12:00:00", "a long description that needs to wrap over several lines")
+    return table
+
+
+def test_a_no_wrap_column_keeps_its_width_when_the_table_is_squeezed():
+    assert _render(_table(), 40) == (
+        " 2024-01-01 12:00:00  a long            \n"
+        "                      description that  \n"
+        "                      needs to wrap     \n"
+        "                      over several      \n"
+        "                      lines             \n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_a_no_wrap_column_that_cannot_fit_is_cropped_not_wrapped():
+    assert _render(_table(width=8), 40) == (
+        " 2024-01…  a long description that      \n"
+        "           needs to wrap over several   \n"
+        "           lines                        \n"
+    )
+    assert _render(_table(width=8, overflow="crop"), 40) == (
+        " 2024-01-  a long description that      \n"
+        "           needs to wrap over several   \n"
+        "           lines                        \n"
+    )
